title: Care and Custody Notice: What the Chain Answers for While a Traded Piece Is in Its Keeping
content:
While a piece taken in under any of the Belrose Trade-In and Upgrade Programmes is in the chain's care, the chain answers for it up to a published amount, and the piece travels under insurance whenever it moves between locations.

| Programme | Largest amount the chain answers for while the piece is in its care (USD) | Piece shipped under insurance between locations |
|---|---|---|
| Belrose Standard Trade-In | 10000 | yes |
| Diamond Trade-Up Guarantee | 50000 | yes |
| Bridal Upgrade Guarantee | 75000 | yes |
| Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee | 150000 | yes |
| Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege | 400000 | yes |
| Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme | 300000 | yes |

## Clause

The amount in the table is the most the chain answers for in respect of one piece in its care under that programme. Shipping under insurance applies under every programme without exception, whichever direction the piece is travelling in.

## Note

The Signature Collection Upgrade Privilege carries the largest custody amount, 400000 USD; the Belrose Standard Trade-In the smallest, 10000 USD. The Estate Purchase and Consignment Programme, at 300000 USD, sits above the Lifetime Diamond Upgrade Guarantee's 150000 USD.
